note: Inputs for scripts/derive-indicators.ts. National values are written by scripts/import/worldbank-indicators.ts; city values are copied from the source named beside each.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city (Urban Audit, DE2009I).

carCommuteShare.basis: Share of journeys to work by car or motorcycle (Urban Audit, TT1012V).

foreignBornShare.basis: Berlin residents born abroad as a share of all residents on 15 May 2022: 889,904 of 3,596,999 (Zensus 2022, table 1000A-1014, EU27, rest of Europe and rest of the world).
foreignBornShare.limitations: From the 2022 census; 4,142 residents whose place of birth is "other" or unknown are counted as not born abroad.

carCommuteShare.basis: Share of journeys to work by car or motorcycle (Urban Audit, TT1012V).

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city (Urban Audit, DE2009I).

carCommuteShare.basis: Share of journeys to work by car or motorcycle (Urban Audit, TT1012V).
carCommuteShare.limitations: From 2011, the latest year published for Madrid; commuting has changed since.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city of Austin (American Community Survey 2024, 1-year).

carCommuteShare.basis: Workers in the city of Austin who commute by car, truck or van as a share of those who travel to work: 66.1% of all workers, of the 75.2% who did not work from home (ACS 2024 1-year, table S0801).
carCommuteShare.limitations: Motorcycles are counted with taxis and other means in S0801 (2.0% of workers), so they are left out; the Urban Audit figures for European cities include them.

climate.limitations: Wikipedia's table is captioned 1991–2020, but its source note gives 1981–2010 for temperatures; the older period is used.

foreignBornShare.basis: Residents of the municipality of Hermosillo born in the United States (0.74%) or another country (0.34%), Encuesta Intercensal 2025, Migración table 2.
foreignBornShare.limitations: A sample survey of people in private dwellings; the share born in another country has a coefficient of variation of 25%. Many residents born in the US are children of Mexican families.

carCommuteShare.basis: Employed residents of the municipality of Hermosillo who travel to work by car or van (57.4%) or motorcycle (2.1%), as a share of those who travel, Encuesta Intercensal 2025, Movilidad cotidiana table 22.
carCommuteShare.limitations: People could name more than one means of travel, so the two shares may overlap slightly; a sample survey.

homicideRate.basis: Municipality of Hermosillo: 374 deaths registered in 2025 as presumed homicides that occurred in the municipality, per 962,020 residents (INEGI, Defunciones por homicidio by municipality of occurrence, preliminary; population from the Encuesta Intercensal 2025).
homicideRate.limitations: 2025 figures are preliminary (263 in 2024, 180 in 2023, so the rate has risen sharply); the municipality includes rural areas; the population counts only people in private dwellings, which makes the rate slightly high. Sonora as a whole: 53.7.

notComparable.USA: The US figure leaves out health insurance premiums, which most people there pay themselves, so it would make US healthcare look nearly free to use.
